messages:
Priya: Sat night — thinking of checking out the Canal Night Market (food stalls + vinyl pop-up). Anyone want to meet up around 7pm? :crescent_moon: 
Sam: Ooh that sounds amazing. Can do 7:15 if that works. 
Jordan: I was planning a short sunset hike up Hawk Ridge but could swing by the market after. What’s the vibe — crowded? dog-friendly? 
Priya: It’s usually chill until 9. Dogs on leash are fine. If a few of us go we can do dinner then hit the vinyl table. 
Lee: I’m game for the market. If Jordan wants the ridge I can join the hike at 5:30 and then meet y’all at 8pm. 
Carlos: I’ll bring cash for the dumplings. Any vegetarian options? 
Priya: Yes, there’s a stall with tofu wraps and a kimchi pancake place. 
Sam: Quick poll: 1) Market only 2) Hike + Market 3) Hike then home (no market). Reply with the number. 
Jordan: 2
Lee: 2
Carlos: 1
Sam: Cool — looks like majority doing hike + market. Meeting spot for hike: parking lot by Old Mill at 5:30. Circle up after on the canal bridge near Booth 12 for 8pm. 
Priya: @Sam putting it in calendar. 
calendar-bot: Event created: "Sat: Hawk Ridge + Canal Night Market" — 5:30PM meetup, location: Old Mill parking lot. 
Sam: Awesome. See you folks Saturday! :wave:
